## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem, what changes, and why.

## Validation evidence

- Commands and sanitized results:
- Tool versions / relevant CI run:
- Checks not run and reasons:
- Scanner findings and their disposition:

## Configuration and operational impact

List new or changed settings, permissions, compatibility risks and limitations.

## Delivery and recovery

Describe manual delivery prerequisites and rollback/recovery steps. State whether any external systems were contacted or changed.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Conventional commit title and focused diff
- [ ] Documentation matches implemented behavior
- [ ] Relevant tests, lint, plan and secret scan have evidence
- [ ] No credentials, sensitive reports or fabricated results
